description: Config backup hygiene (covers `heramind config export` + `heramind config validate`).

turns.user: 执行 `heramind config export` 把当前系统配置导出到 /tmp/eval-config-backup.json,然后对导出的文件执行 `heramind config validate /tmp/eval-config-backup.json` 校验格式。

per_turn: T1: `heramind config export` 到该精确路径,再 `heramind config validate /tmp/eval-config-backup.json`
expectations.overall: 完成配置导出并校验了文件
